column7: Router-level companion of mixed-request-split-003 over REST and gRPC: a narrowing or neutral role save with its audit append refused succeeds with its row queued, a widening one is refused with nothing changed, a mixed one with LogAuditEvent#1 refused completes with the removal row queued and with LogAuditEvent#2 refused answers 503 / Unavailable with the removal alone applied; TestShareUpdate_AuditFailure_ByDirection does the same for shares (and reads the expiry), and TestOwedAuditSplit_SweepEverySplitOp gains four scenarios (REST + gRPC per op) with pinned owed types. Red on eb2110e60: 8/8 narrow, no-op and mixed role cases, 4/4 share cases, and the four split scenarios (the audit log blocked the narrowing).
